image_description: A vertical traffic light suspended from a horizontal wire against a blue sky with clouds. The traffic light has three circular lenses; the bottom lens is illuminated green, while the top two appear dark (red and amber). Tree branches with green leaves frame the top and right side of the image. A dark horizontal line (likely another wire or cable) crosses the lower middle section.
